description: CloudSync webhook delivery issue should route to integration support with KB grounding.

input.subject: Webhook from CloudSync not reaching PagerDuty
input.body:
Our CloudSync webhooks are not being delivered to PagerDuty. We've verified the endpoint is reachable and the secret is correctly configured.

Last successful delivery: earlier today
Failed deliveries since: 4731

Webhook logs attached. Please advise.

description: New users blocked by SSO should map to auth/onboarding support and auth KB.

input.subject: SSO configuration not working for new users — CloudSync
input.body:
We set up SSO for CloudSync last month and it works for existing users, but new joiners can't authenticate.

Error they see: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: downstream service unreachable

Our IDP: Salesforce
Plan: Business

Please help — we have 308 people blocked from accessing the platform.

input.subject: Data not syncing between SecureVault and Jira
input.body:
Our SecureVault instance stopped syncing with Jira approximately last week. We're now seeing a 140-record discrepancy.

Sync config has not changed. Last successful sync: last week.

Please help us restore sync and recover the missing records.
